name: Defensive Coloration
body:
Prerequisite(s): 12th-level symbiant.

Benefit(s): You can use the Stealth skill to hide, even if the terrain doesn’t grant cover or concealment. At 17th level, you can use the Stealth skill even while being observed.

This counts as the ranger’s camouflage and hide in plain sight abilities.
